items.title: Chris Olave: Good to go Sunday
items.text:
Olave (foot) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Vikings, Mike Triplett of NewOrleans.Football reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jordan Addison: Questionable for Week 5
items.text:
Addison (hamstring) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game in New Orleans, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

items.title: Ashton Jeanty: Questionable for Sunday
items.text:
Jeanty (ankle/foot) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Patriots, with Raiders coach Klint Kubiak saying Friday that the running back will "do his best to go,"Levi Edwards of the Raiders' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Chris Olave: Practicing again Friday
items.text:
Olave (rest/foot) appeared to be moving well during the part of Friday's practice open to the media, Jeff Nowak of WWL New Orleans reports.
